name: Fever API
tagline: Curated experiences and local-event marketplace API for discovery, ticketing, and bookings
description: Fever provides a public OAuth 2.0 MCP server for searching cities, events, activities, and experiences with real-time data. Fever also offers approved business partners API access for catalog integration, real-time availability and pricing, and booking management. The MCP service is currently free; broader transactional integrations require partner onboarding.

auth.details: Partner/integration credentials; public self-serve API key signup not clearly documented. Contact Fever for access.

example.request: curl -sS -X POST 'https://data-search.apigw.feverup.com/mcp/' -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -H 'MCP-Protocol-Version: 2025-06-18' --data-raw '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"search_events","arguments":{"city_code":"MAD","locale":"en","page_size":10}}}'

use_cases: search curated local experiences in a city
list available ticket options for an experience
integrate Fever inventory into a travel or city guide app
